defs: Further training a pre-trained model on targeted data.
Supervised fine-tuning on prompt–response pairs, response-only loss.
SFT over many tasks phrased as instructions.
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning: freeze the base, train few parameters.
Learn virtual token embeddings at the input.
Learn key/value prefixes at every layer.
Low-rank update ΔW = BA added to frozen W.

confused: Any supervised pairs vs many instruction-formatted tasks.
Parallel low-rank update (mergeable) vs inserted layers (extra latency).
Weight arithmetic vs training a student.
recall.minute: Fine-tuning adapts a base model to a format, task, domain or style; full fine-tuning updates all weights (7B ≈ 112 GB with Adam) and risks forgetting. SFT trains on prompt–response pairs with response-only loss (8-token example: 1.250 all vs 0.450 response). Instruction tuning mixes many task types for zero-shot instruction following. PEFT: prompt tuning (n·d params), prefix tuning (n·L·2d), adapters (bottleneck layers, small latency), LoRA ΔW = BA, r(d + k) params: r = 8 on 1000 × 1000 → 16,000 (1.6%); 7B with r = 16 on Q, V → 8.4M (0.12%); B = 0 at init; merge for zero latency. QLoRA: 4-bit NF4 base, double quantization, paged optimizers (7B ≈ 3.6 GB). Merging: θ_base + Στᵢ (task vectors), TIES/DARE reduce interference. Distillation: student matches teacher's soft outputs at temperature T (T²·KL). Catastrophic forgetting: mitigate with replay, PEFT, regularisation, small LR, broad evaluation.
